nodes.label: Demo Mode
nodes.rationale: Fallback operating mode when Supabase is unreachable or not configured: all DB functions no-op (guarded by !sb||demoMode) so the UI keeps working with local demo data. Login failure explicitly offers 'Modo demo' as a continuation path.

nodes.label: Role Permission Guard (can/guardAction/applyPermissions)
nodes.rationale: Two roles only: admin can do everything; operator is blocked from destructive actions (delete_contact, delete_lead, delete_chat, delete_message). Delete buttons are hidden in the DOM for non-admins on desktop and mobile.

nodes.label: deleteContactFromDB (Cascade Delete)
nodes.rationale: Deletes a contact and its full trail in cascade order: messages -> conversations -> leads -> contacts, done client-side because there is no DB-level cascade.

nodes.label: syncShopifyNow
nodes.rationale: Requires a real Supabase session token (not demo mode) before calling the server-side Shopify sync, so Shopify credentials never reach the client.

nodes.label: Supabase Realtime Subsystem
nodes.rationale: WebSocket subscription to postgres_changes on messages/contacts/leads. Designed around mobile PWA suspension: the OS kills the socket, so the app resyncs on visibilitychange only if the channel died or the app was hidden >10s (a short desktop blur/focus should NOT tear down a healthy channel and reload 500 rows). A 25s backup poll covers WebViews where the socket stays 'alive' but stops delivering events. Duplicate delivery is handled by id-based dedup plus reconciling optimistic local messages (no id) by txt+time.

nodes.label: Web Push / VAPID Notifications
nodes.rationale: The VAPID public key is fetched from the server (/api/push-public-key) instead of being hardcoded so the keys live only in Vercel environment variables. Apple silently invalidates push endpoints over time (without firing pushsubscriptionchange), so on startup the code checks the current subscription endpoint against the push_subscriptions table and forces re-subscription if the server already purged it (404/410).

nodes.label: loadAIAgentStats
nodes.rationale: Computes 7-day AI KPIs client-side from raw messages rows: unique leads, AI-answered conversations, weekend activity, escalation rate (conversations where a human 'agent'/'out' sender appeared), unanswered conversations, average AI response latency, and text vs voice credit usage.

nodes.label: aiaActions (Editable AI Agent Rules)
nodes.rationale: Cuando/Hacer/Mas rule triples define the sales bot playbook: qualify leads by m2 before recommending, never dump the full price list, escalate to a human on purchase intent, invoicing, discounts, or safety concerns, one follow-up at 24h then mark lead FRIO.

nodes.label: messages Table (Supabase)
nodes.rationale: sender column is DB CHECK-constrained to in|out|note|tpl|ai; UI senders 'agent' and 'customer' are mapped to 'out'/'in' before insert.

nodes.label: Política de Privacidad (Privacy Policy)
nodes.rationale: Spanish-language privacy policy (updated 2026-05-29) required for Meta platform compliance: covers data collected, use, sharing, 30-day retention/deletion, user rights, and security measures (HTTPS/TLS, role-restricted access).

nodes.label: Konversa CRM
nodes.rationale: CRM platform operated by Grupo Pingus that receives and manages customer messages from Facebook Messenger, Instagram Direct, and WhatsApp Business for sales follow-up and agent coordination; data used only for service operation, never sold or used for third-party advertising.

nodes.label: Meta (Facebook) Platform API
nodes.rationale: Konversa CRM uses the Meta API to receive Messenger messages for the Grupo Pingus Facebook Page; Facebook user ID and public name arrive automatically, message content is stored securely, access restricted to authorized staff.

nodes.label: Data Deletion Mechanism
nodes.rationale: Users can request full deletion via email (privacidad@grupopingus.com) or the /api/delete-data form; processed within 30 business days unless law requires retention — satisfies Meta's data deletion callback requirement for platform apps.
